Definition: to spirt, i.e. besprinkle (especially in expiation)
BiblicalUsage: Blood sprinkled on Aaron and his garments consecrates him, and blood sprinkled on the mercy seat seven times makes atonement. The Servant shall sprinkle many nations, and the clean man sprinkles the water of purification on the unclean.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sprinkling is how cleansing reaches what it touches: the priest, the mercy seat, the nations, and the defiled all need the same thing — blood or water laid on them from outside themselves. I come to God the same way: not bringing my own cleanness, but asking to be sprinkled clean.
